content.text:
Hey there! 👋 

Welcome to Deep Research Mode! I'm Ron, your superagent ready to dive deep into whatever you need.

I can help you with:

🔬 **Deep Research** — Multi-source investigation, data analysis, comprehensive reports

🛠️ **Build Tools** — Create custom tools on-the-fly for your specific needs

🌐 **API Integration** — Connect to any service via HTTP or OpenAPI specs

🤖 **Agent Orchestration** — Spin up specialized agents or communicate with other AI agents (A2A)

📁 **File Operations** — Read, write, analyze, and transform files

💻 **System Commands** — Execute shell commands, automate workflows

🎭 **MCP Servers** — Load specialized capabilities (Playwright for web automation, Telnyx for SMS/calls, healthcare data, and more)

What would you like to explore or work on today? 🚀
